podcast.title: All-Electronic Drumming on "Send Me an Angel"
podcast.body: The 1983 song "Send Me an Angel" by Australian band Real Life is remarkable for containing not a single acoustic drum sound. All drumming on the track was performed on a Simmons electronic kit by Danny Simzick, making it a pure example of early electronic percussion. "There is not a single acoustic drum sound on this record and everything is played on a Simmons electronic kit."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: History of the Modern Drum Kit

xref.title: Virtual AI Singer-Songwriter
xref.body: Anna Indiana is a virtual AI singer-songwriter who does not exist in real life. Her entire persona and musical output, including her debut single "Betrayed by this Town," are products of artificial intelligence, showcasing the capabilities of AI in creating a complete musical artist. "Hello world, my name is Anna Indiana and I'm so excited to share my music with you."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History and Future of AI in Music
